# Wallet domain: physical model

*Generated by `scripts/generate/diagrams.py` from `target/manifest.json`. Don't edit this file: change the YAML, run `dbt parse`, then run the script. CI fails if it's out of date.*

The mart models of the wallet domain (a consumer contract), at their latest versions: every column with its contracted type, primary keys (PK), and the relationships the tests check (FK). A model from another domain shows only the key a relationship uses; its own domain's page has the rest. `||--o{` points from a key that is unique; `}|--o{` from a key that has versions, so several rows share it.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    mart_wallet__credentials {
        string credential_key PK
        string learner_key FK
        string credential_kind
        string credential_name
        string issued_by
        date issued_on
        string status
        date revoked_on
        int credit_points
    }
    mart_wallet__learners {
        string learner_key PK
        string full_name
        string email
        string status
        string enrolled_award_name
        string enrolled_award_type
        int credit_points_required
        int credit_points_earned
        int credit_points_remaining
        int credentials_held
        int awards_held
        int microcredentials_held
        int badges_held
        int credentials_revoked
    }
    mart_wallet__learners ||--o{ mart_wallet__credentials : "learner_key"
```

| Model | Grain | Access | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mart_wallet__credentials` | One row per credential, as it is now. | protected | enforced |
| `mart_wallet__learners` | One row per learner, as it is now. | protected | enforced |
